author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Direct-hit submission emits out-of-range hit indexes instead of rejecting them locally.
findings.consequence: A user can enter an ordinal greater than the displayed total hit count; the parent lookup rejects it and navigation silently stays put, leaving the opened input without feedback that the submitted hit cannot exist.
findings.evidence: submitGoto validates only that gotoOrdinal is a positive integer, then emits Number(gotoOrdinal.value) - 1. The component already receives totalHits and only exposes this form when totalHits is known through canNavigate, while the direct parent's editorHitLookupContext rejects indexes >= response.total_hits and navigateToHit returns without surfacing an error.
findings.recommendation: Before emitting, compare the parsed one-based ordinal with props.totalHits and refocus or mark the input invalid when it is outside 1..props.totalHits; emit only known in-range indexes.
verification: Inspected canNavigate and props lines 6-32 to confirm totalHits is available when the direct-hit form is enabled.
